shared_elements: low-relief carving of figures on a flat ground
justification: Both surfaces show shallow-relief bearded male figures strictly in profile, with the same conventions for musculature, curled hair/beard, patterned garment hems and carried weapons including a bow, which suggests a shared manner of depiction. The scenes themselves differ sharply: A shows two static figures facing each other in a ceremonial exchange of held objects over an inscribed field, while B shows a dynamic chariot drawn by horses with an archer confronting animals, involving vehicle, wheel and animals absent from A.
